title_sq: Tek Mei's Garden, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!!
description_sq: Tek Mei's Garden, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!! Prona ndodhet ne katin 9 te nje pallati 11 katesh si dhe ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 141.99 m2, nga ku 119.61 m2 eshte siperfaqe neto. Apartamenti organizohet nga korridori shperndares, dhoma e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete si dhe 3 ballkone. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte Lindje-Perendim. Aktualisht ndertimi ndodhet ne faze karabinaje dhe ka cilesi te larte ne ndertim. Kompleksi do te kete hapesira rekreative dhe kende lojerash per femije. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nder me te kerkuarat ne Tirane dhe ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode dhe te qete.
title_en: At Mei's Garden, Super Apartment 2+1+2, With Regular Layout!!!
description_en: At Mei's Garden, Super Apartment 2+1+2, With Regular Layout!!! The property is located on the 9th floor of an 11-story building and has a total area of ​​141.99 m2, of which 119.61 m2 is the net area. The apartment is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 3 balconies. The orientation of the apartment is East-West. Currently, the building is in the construction stage and has high quality in construction. The complex will have recreational spaces and playgrounds for children. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most sought after in Tirana and offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
